description: This file defines API routes/endpoints for managing customer service requests, including creation, retrieval, updating status, listing with filters, and fetching request history. It sets up dependency injection for a singleton in-memory data repository and interacts with a service layer to perform business logic operations.

methods.name: RequestService get_service()
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of RequestService, initializing a global in-memory repository if not already created.

methods.name: ServiceRequestOut create_request( payload: ServiceRequestCreate, svc: RequestService = Depends(get_service) )
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new customer service request.

methods.name: ServiceRequestOut get_request( id: str = Path(..., description="The unique identifier of the service request"), svc: RequestService = Depends(get_service), )
methods.description: Retrieves a service request by its ID.

methods.name: ServiceRequestOut update_request_status( payload: StatusUpdateCreate, id: str = Path(..., description="The unique identifier of the service request"), svc: RequestService = Depends(get_service), )
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing service request.

methods.name: ServiceRequestListResponse list_requests( status: Optional[StatusEnum] = Query(None, description="Optional status filter"), q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Optional free-text search (title/description)"), customer_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by customer id"), created_from: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Include requests created on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)"), created_to: Optional[date] = Query(None, description="Include requests created on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)"), page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="Page number"), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Page size"), svc: RequestService = Depends(get_service), )
methods.description: Lists service requests with optional filtering, pagination, and ordering.

methods.name: ServiceRequestHistoryResponse get_request_history( id: str = Path(..., description="The unique identifier of the service request"), svc: RequestService = Depends(get_service), )
methods.description: Retrieves the chronological history of status changes for a given service request.
